stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2024 entering class: 7,285 applied, 5,352 admitted, 715 enrolled; 109 enrolled students submitted SAT, 27 ACT). Lynn's 2025-26 Common Data Set is on spiral.lynn.edu/common-data-set/11 but could not be downloaded (HTTP 403 to scripted requests), so international applicants/admits, GPA and SAT total are not filled in. SAT/ACT percentiles are for enrolled students who submitted scores (a small, self-selected group of a test-optional school); no SAT total percentile is published.

cds_test_policy.notes: Lynn is test-optional: SAT, ACT and CLT scores are not required (check the test-optional box on the application).
